tracks.title: 01 · Leakage → Clean pre-event
tracks.description: Original MViT, shortcut discovery, unsuccessful matching, grouped cleanup, clean retraining and independent test.
tracks.scope: Early 4 s pre-event sampling; non-visual baselines and clean video model.

tracks.title: 02 · Event-centered detection
tracks.description: Linear versus MLP classifier heads, checkpoint-loaded test discrepancy, and threshold caveats.
tracks.scope: 4-second clips roughly centered on event; post-event frames may be available.

tracks.title: 03 · Alert-aware anticipation
tracks.description: Time-dependent labels, attention-pooling baseline A and Transformer+CNN model B.
tracks.scope: Pre-alert versus alert-to-event labels; 273 validation clips, no independent test documented.

tracks.title: 04 · Full-video detection
tracks.description: Final notebook-based detection run with independently reported 225-video test metrics.
tracks.scope: 16 evenly spaced frames across the full video; post-collision evidence may be included.

steps.title: Original MViT
steps.change: Train first MViT on unmatched clip placements

settings.Clip: 4 s, 16 frames at 224×224; 1 s warning margin
settings.Logged training: 9 epochs; best validation-loss checkpoint at epoch 6

steps.result: By epoch 9 train F1 increased but validation performance varied.
steps.interpretation: The run establishes the first visual baseline, but the sampling protocol has untested shortcuts.
steps.caveat: Epoch 7 has higher AUC; epoch 6 was chosen by loss/F1, not maximum AUC.

steps.title: Metadata shortcut audit
steps.change: Test whether timing metadata predicts labels without pixels
steps.result: Timing and metadata alone discriminated collision labels above chance.
steps.interpretation: An AUC of 0.700 without images is evidence of a sampling shortcut, not a valid learned video cue.
steps.caveat: Different estimators and validation protocols should not be equated.

steps.title: Visual / temporal ablations
steps.change: Destroy or isolate temporal/spatial inputs in original checkpoint

settings.Changes: Static frame, shuffled time, borders-only, center-only

steps.result: Static frames hurt strongly; shuffled time remained relatively strong.
steps.interpretation: This is evidence of dependence on changing frames, but weaker evidence for precise temporal order.
steps.caveat: This ablation is on original data/checkpoint, not the final clean run.

steps.title: Greedy matching (failed)
steps.change: Match negatives on time_after_clip one video at a time
steps.result: Start-time balance got worse; later classifier re-check exposed a new duration/tail problem.
steps.interpretation: Rejected because the approach matched the wrong variable and distorted the joint distribution.
steps.caveat: Heuristic AUC 0.536 is not interchangeable with later properly fitted CV AUC.

steps.title: Global candidate pool
steps.change: Pool 30 negative placements/video and stratify by 2D time bins
steps.result: KS checks improved, but 52 repeated video IDs could cross folds.
steps.interpretation: Matching succeeded on checked distributions but final cross-validation needed grouping/deduplication.
steps.caveat: Raw KFold AUC 0.695–0.745 was contaminated by duplicate-source leakage.

steps.title: Deduplicate + grouped validation
steps.change: Remove duplicate video IDs, balance classes, use source-video grouping
steps.result: Tested metadata-only classifiers now perform near chance.
steps.interpretation: Specific checked timing shortcuts no longer provide useful separation.
steps.caveat: Does not prove the absence of every form of data leakage.

steps.title: Clean-data retraining
steps.change: Retrain MViT with deduplicated, balanced, grouped dataset

settings.Selection: Best val loss epoch 4; early stopping epoch 7

steps.result: Validation F1 increased slightly against the old selected checkpoint despite removal of shortcuts.
steps.interpretation: The cleaner data supported similar visual performance; this is a more credible validation run.
steps.caveat: Original and clean splits need care in comparisons.

steps.title: Independent pre-event test
steps.change: Evaluate selected clean model on video-grouped holdout
steps.result: Reports held-out performance with an uncertainty interval.
steps.interpretation: This is the confirmed clean pre-event test result from log.md.
steps.caveat: Do not conflate it with the later alert-aware A/B validation experiments.

steps.title: MViT + linear head
steps.change: Use a single linear classifier on pretrained MViT-v2-S

settings.Training: 7 epochs logged; backbone frozen epochs 1–2, unfrozen at 3

steps.interpretation: Reference architecture for the MLP comparison.
steps.caveat: Validation only; no independent test recorded for this specific baseline.

steps.title: MViT + MLP head
steps.change: Replace linear classifier with two-hidden-layer MLP

settings.Training: 7 logged epochs; batch 4; AdamW; backbone LR 1e-5, head LR 1e-4, WD .05

steps.result: MLP validation F1 higher than linear head; best AUC at epoch 4.
steps.interpretation: Architecture change is promising, but experimental controls need verification.
steps.caveat: Best validation checkpoint selection should be verified against training code.

steps.title: Checkpoint test / threshold audit
steps.change: Load checkpoint explicitly and re-evaluate test instead of using the in-memory weights
steps.result: Explicit checkpoint test differs from earlier reported evaluation.
steps.interpretation: Shows why checkpoint identity and evaluation protocol are part of reproducibility.
steps.caveat: Test threshold sweep at .40 yielded F1 .7351, but it is exploratory test-set tuning, not an independently selected operating point.

steps.title: Alert-aware temporal labels
steps.change: Define per-window class before-alert vs alert-to-collision

settings.Targets: Before alert=0; alert→event=1; after event excluded

steps.result: Class balance and evaluation protocol differ from clean pre-event run 1.
steps.interpretation: Defines the different early-warning target for Models A/B.
steps.caveat: The training uses weighted sampling; raw training F1 is not directly comparable with unweighted validation F1.

steps.title: Attention-pooling model A
steps.change: Use MViT features with per-frame spatial pooling and attention over time

settings.Architecture: MViT-v2-S; attention-pool + mean + max + CLS → MLP
settings.Optimizer groups: Lower backbone 1e-6; top 4 5e-6; head 2e-5; weight decay .01

steps.result: AUC 0.7571 at epoch 15; F1 depends strongly on threshold.
steps.interpretation: Completed temporal baseline A; threshold-tuned validation is an in-sample selection metric.
steps.caveat: No independent test in this alert-aware series. Saved filename overlaps with B.

steps.title: Temporal Transformer + CNN B
steps.change: Replace temporal attention-pooling head with Transformer plus multi-scale Conv1D

settings.Architecture: 2 Transformer encoder layers, 8 heads; CNN kernel sizes 3/5/7
settings.Optimizer: Planned head LR 2e-5 vs printed first epoch head LR 5e-6; discrepancy unresolved

steps.result: Epoch 8 scores; not a completed run nor an independent test.
steps.interpretation: B looks competitive but cannot be declared the final winner from this partial log.
steps.caveat: No independent test; checkpoint filename shared with A. LR discrepancy must be checked.

steps.title: Full-video final detection
steps.change: Sample frames across complete video (before and potentially after collision)

settings.Architecture: MViT-v2-S with temporal Transformer + multi-scale CNN head

steps.result: Best published test classification metrics for full-video detection.
steps.interpretation: Detection performance when observing the video, not validated lead-time anticipation.
steps.caveat: Cannot compare directly with 170-clip pre-event test or 273-clip alert-aware validation.
